name: lattice-parallel-wave
title: Productize Lattice Parallel Wave planning for multi-story worktree delivery
description: Add a Lattice-compatible Parallel Wave contract and CLI surface so large demands can be split into related stories, planned as a DAG, dispatched across worktrees/hosts with capability-aware degradations, tracked through portable evidence/lineage, and merged in a safe order without confusing local workflow with production authority.
